run_pipeline_generate_image: run the HunyuanImagePipeline to generate an image from a text prompt with configurable steps and guidance scale
extract_glyph_text_from_prompt: extract quoted text from a prompt string for glyph rendering using single, double, and Chinese quote patterns
encode_prompt_with_qwen_and_byt5: encode a text prompt into dual embeddings using Qwen2.5-VL for main text and ByT5 for glyph text
retrieve_timesteps_from_scheduler: retrieve timesteps from a diffusion scheduler with support for custom timesteps or sigmas
prepare_latents_for_generation: prepare random latent tensors for the diffusion denoising loop with configurable batch size and dimensions
